formula: housing ~ section8 + linyime + s8lint + (1 | id)
notes: RESPONSE INFERRED: longitudinal homelessness study, id repeats over occasions (time); housing (1/2) the modeled outcome, section8 the voucher treatment, linyime linear time, s8lint section8*time product. No labels. RULE GAP: s8lint is a precomputed interaction column, filed as a covariate not an a:b term. housing takes 0/1/2 (street, community, independent; the San Francisco homeless study of Hedeker & Gibbons), so ordinal, not binary (merge refusal, corrected 2026-10-08).

formula: math ~ homework + ses + meanses + white + parented + public + percmin + (1 | schid)
notes: RESPONSE INFERRED: students (stuid) in schools (schid), math achievement the outcome, homework the predictor of interest (Kreft & de Leeuw homework data). Pupil-level ses/homework/white/parented and school-level meanses/public/percmin covariates.

formula: lnhr ~ lnwg + kids + ageh + agesq + disab + (1 | id)
notes: RESPONSE INFERRED: labour-supply panel, id repeats over year; log hours (lnhr) the outcome, log wage (lnwg) and demographics covariates. agesq = ageh^2. No labels.

formula: mathach ~ ses + female + minority + sector + pracad + disclim + mnses + (1 | schoolid)
notes: High School & Beyond; recalled the canonical Raudenbush & Bryk HLM model (mathach on ses with a school random intercept, often a random ses slope and a sector cross-level term). mnses the school mean ses. Precomputed columns (mean, sd, xb, resid, pickone, se*) ignored. RULE GAP: a random ses slope (1 + ses | schoolid) is the fuller model; filed with a random intercept.

formula: chosen ~ price + cost + range + electric + gas + hybrid + highperf + medhiperf + (1 | id)
notes: RESPONSE INFERRED: stated-preference car-choice conjoint; respondent id makes repeated choice situations, chosen (0/1) the picked alternative. Mixed/conditional logit with a respondent random intercept; situation is the choice-set id. No labels.

formula: Surv(start, stop, infection) ~ treat + (1 | id)
notes: RESPONSE INFERRED: recurrent-infection survival (CGD-type trial), patient id repeats over infection events (number); treat the randomised treatment, center the multi-centre cluster. #22/#24 survival convention: event indicator infection kept in Surv() and in ignore. Few labels.

formula: mathgain ~ mathkind + girl + minority + ses + yearstea + mathknow + mathprep + housepov + (1 | schoolid) + (1 | schoolid:classid)
notes: The 'classroom' data (West, Welch & Galecki, Linear Mixed Models). Children (childid) nested in classes (classid) nested in schools (schoolid); math gain the outcome, mathkind the kindergarten baseline. Recalled the three-level random-intercept model.

formula: ravens ~ treatment * relyear + age_at_time0 + boy + (1 | schoolid) + (1 | schoolid:id)
notes: ch8 do-file: mixed ravens ib4.treatment##c.relyear age_at_time0 i.boy || schoolid: || id: (three-level random intercept). Kenya nutrition-intervention cognitive study. gender duplicates boy; alternate test scores ignored.

formula: satis ~ husband + lmarr + close + commit + (1 | couple)
notes: RESPONSE INFERRED: dyadic data, couple has two members (husband 0/1); marital satisfaction (satis, 4-level ordinal) the outcome, closeness/commitment the other attitudes, lmarr length of marriage. close/commit/satis are category dtypes.

formula: fte ~ post * state + (1 | store)
notes: ch5 do-file: xtset store post; treated = state*post; xtreg fte post treated, fe (Card & Krueger minimum-wage DiD). Fixed-effects panel rendered with a store random intercept (#22 convention); treated is the post:state interaction, stores nested in state.

formula: Surv(time, death) ~ mage + I(mage^2) + border + prevbirth + pdead + nextbirth + (1 | momid)
notes: ch14 do-file: discrete-time survival expanded by interval then mecloglog y ... || momid: (random-intercept complementary log-log). Children (kidid, one row each) nested in mothers (momid); Guatemala child mortality. Survival convention: death kept in Surv() and ignore; p0014-f1223 are the dummy expansions of prevbirth/nextbirth.

formula: attain ~ p7vrq + p7read + dadocc + dadunemp + daded + momed + male + deprive + (1 | neighid) + (1 | schid)
notes: Scottish cross-classified neighbourhood-and-school data (Garner & Raudenbush); pupils cross-classified by neighbourhood (neighid) and school (schid), educational attainment the outcome. Recalled the cross-classified model. dummy ignored.

formula: y ~ N + G + N:G + (1 | col)
notes: RESPONSE INFERRED: small field trial, y the yield; N (nitrogen, 3 levels) and G (genotype, 2 levels) the treatments, col the replicate/block, row the spatial coordinate (ignored, #22). No labels. RULE GAP: design undocumented; block (col) and factor coding inferred from the layout.

formula: performance ~ pcountry + jcountry + (1 | pair) + (1 | judge)
notes: RESPONSE INFERRED: figure-skating scores cross-classified by skating pair and judge; technical score (performance) the outcome, program the artistic score (alternate response, ignored), pcountry/jcountry the nationalities behind the nationalistic-bias question. Labels sparse.

formula: luclms ~ ez + year + (1 | city)
notes: Enterprise-zone difference-in-differences panel (Papke): city observed in two years (1983/1984), log unemployment claims (luclms) the outcome, ez the enterprise-zone indicator. Panel grouped by city.

formula: pat ~ logr + logk + (1 | cusip)
notes: Hausman-Hall-Griliches patents-R&D count panel; firm (cusip) observed over years, patent counts (pat) the outcome, log R&D (logr) and log capital (logk) covariates. Lagged pat1-pat4 and logr1-logr5 ignored. Recalled the Poisson panel.

formula: pass_read ~ female + isei + high_school + college + one_for + both_for + test_lang + (1 | schoolid)
notes: RESPONSE INFERRED: PISA 2000 USA reading, students in schools (schoolid); passing reading proficiency (pass_read) the outcome, socio-economic index (isei) and background covariates. Survey weights (w_fstuwt, wnrschbw) and variance strata ignored. female is a category dtype.

formula: stops ~ eth + crime + offset(log(arrests)) + (1 | precinct)
notes: NYC stop-and-frisk data (Gelman, ARM ch.15): stop counts by precinct, ethnicity (eth) and crime type (crime), offset by log arrests. Recalled the ARM Poisson multilevel model. precinct the grouping; arrests the offset.

formula: gsp ~ public + private + emp + unemp + (1 | state)
notes: Munnell public-capital productivity panel; 48 states (state, nested in region) over 1970-1986, log gross state product (gsp) the outcome. hwy/water/other the components of public (ignored). Panel grouped by state.

formula: w ~ sex + dose + (1 | dam)
notes: Rat-pups teratology data (West et al.): pups (rat) nested in litters (dam), birth weight (w) the outcome, dose the treatment applied to the dam, sex a pup covariate. Recalled the litter random-intercept model.

formula: y ~ wsm + wsf + wsm:wsf + (1 | male) + (1 | female)
notes: ch16 do-file: melogit y wsm wsf ww || group: R.m || f: (crossed random effects for males and females). Classic salamander-mating data; y the mating success, wsm/wsf the whiteside indicators, ww = wsm*wsf (rendered wsm:wsf). m/f are male/female recoded within group; filed on the raw male/female ids. rbm/rbf the complementary roughbutt indicators.

formula: imps ~ week * treatment + (1 | id)
notes: ch11 do-file: meologit impso c.weeksqrt##i.treatment || id: (ordinal, subject random intercept). NIMH schizophrenia drug trial; imps the IMPS severity (half-integer, >10 levels, filed continuous), impso its 4-category ordinal recode (not in the table), weeksqrt = sqrt(week). RULE GAP: the documented model is ordinal on a recoded response absent from the table; filed the raw imps as continuous.

formula: score ~ pfsm + pvr1 + female + vr + ethnic + schgend + schden + (1 | school)
notes: RESPONSE INFERRED: UK school value-added data, pupils in schools (school); exam score the outcome, verbal-reasoning band (vr) and intake composition covariates. ethnic/schgend/schden are category dtypes. year a cohort index (ignored). RULE GAP: grouping school inferred; year could instead index a cross-classified cohort.

formula: debut ~ arm + sex + scpar + (1 | school)
notes: RESPONSE INFERRED: SHARE school-based sex-education cluster RCT, pupils in 25 schools (school); onset of sexual activity (debut, 0/1) the primary outcome, arm the randomised intervention, scpar social class. kscore (knowledge) and regret are alternate/subset outcomes (ignored).

formula: deaths ~ uv + offset(log(expected)) + (1 | nation) + (1 | nation:region)
notes: EC skin-cancer mortality disease-mapping (Langford et al.): counties (county, one row each) nested in regions nested in nations; death counts the outcome, uv the UV exposure, offset by log expected. Recalled the Poisson multilevel model. const ignored.

formula: birwt ~ smoke + male + mage + hsgrad + somecoll + collgrad + married + black + kessner2 + kessner3 + novisit + pretri2 + pretri3 + (1 | momid)
notes: ch3 do-file: mixed birwt smoke male mage hsgrad somecoll collgrad married black kessner2 kessner3 novisit pretri2 pretri3 || momid: (mother random intercept). Abrevaya sibling birth-weight/smoking panel; smoke/male/black are category dtypes, magesq = mage^2, cigs/gestat alternate measures (ignored).

formula: treads ~ classt + gender + race + frlnch + (1 | schid) + (1 | schid:class)
notes: RESPONSE INFERRED: Project STAR class-size experiment; students in classes (class = school*teacher*grade) in schools (schid), reading score (treads) the outcome, class type (classt) the treatment. Large merged file; tmaths an alternate response, race/weight columns ignored. RULE GAP: student (stdntid) repeats across grades, so a pupil random effect is also defensible.

formula: reading ~ classt + gender + race + frlnch + (1 | school)
notes: RESPONSE INFERRED: Project STAR multiple-membership file; the wttr*/gr*wttr* columns are teacher-membership weights across grades, reading the outcome, classt the treatment. Filed with a school random intercept; the teacher multiple-membership structure (gr0tchid-gr2tchid with weights) is not representable in the registry, so those weight columns remain in the table unmodelled. RULE GAP: multiple-membership random effect not expressible.

formula: lntax ~ lntpi + prep + ms + hh + depend + age + emp + (1 | subject)
notes: RESPONSE INFERRED: panel of tax filers, subject observed over time; log tax (lntax) the outcome, log income (lntpi) and prep (used a preparer) covariates. tpi/tax the raw levels of the logged columns (ignored). Labels uninformative.

formula: rep ~ male + pped + mses + (1 | schoolid)
notes: Thailand grade-repetition multilevel logit (Rabe-Hesketh & Skrondal / gllamm): pupils in schools (schoolid), grade repetition (rep, 0/1) the outcome, pre-primary education (pped) and school mean SES (mses) covariates. wt1 a frequency weight for the collapsed covariate patterns (ignored). Recalled the model.

formula: outcome ~ treatment * month + (1 | patient)
notes: ch10 do-file: melogit outcome i.treatment##c.month || patient: (also xtlogit and gllamm). Toenail dermatophyte onychomycosis trial; outcome (0/1 severity) the response, treatment and month the covariates, visit the occasion index (ignored).

formula: tlm ~ level + age + sex + (1 | famnum) + (1 | famnum:id)
notes: RESPONSE INFERRED: Tower of London cognitive task (Rabe-Hesketh, Skrondal & Pickles): subjects (id) within families (famnum) measured at task levels (level, -1/0/1); tlm the Tower-of-London measure. Alternate measures (tlpl, tlsub, dtlm) ignored, group the family-type. RULE GAP: several correlated measures per occasion; filed tlm as the response.

formula: Choice ~ GC + Ttime + (1 | traveler)
notes: ch12 do-file: clogit Choice GC Ttime, group(traveler) (conditional logit; cmclogit variant). Greene travel-mode choice; each traveler faces 4 alternatives (alt), Choice the chosen one, GC generalised cost, Ttime terminal time. #23 conditional-logit convention: rendered with a traveler random intercept. Hinc/Psize enter only the alternative-interaction variant.

formula: thk ~ prethk + cc + tv + cc:tv + (1 | school) + (1 | school:class)
notes: Television School and Family Smoking Prevention trial (TVSFP): students in classes (class) in schools (school); tobacco-health knowledge (thk) the outcome, prethk the pretest, cc (curriculum) and tv (media) the crossed interventions. Recalled the two-level model (Stata [ME] meglm example); cc:tv the design interaction.

formula: h ~ type + sex + (1 | pair)
notes: RESPONSE INFERRED: Hay twin data, two members per pair (pair, long form); h the 0/1 phenotype, type the zygosity (d/m), freq a frequency weight for the aggregated response patterns (ignored). RULE GAP: aggregated by pattern with a frequency weight; filed h as the twin phenotype at low confidence.

formula: y ~ novice + (1 | rater) + (1 | video)
notes: RESPONSE INFERRED: ratings of videos cross-classified by rater and video; y the rating (count, 0-19), novice whether the rater is a novice. Cross-classified random effects. No labels.

formula: lwage ~ black + hisp + union + married + exper + educ + year + (1 + exper | nr)
notes: ch5/ch6 do-file: mixed lwage black hisp union married exper yeart educt || nr: exper, covariance(unstructured) (random intercept and exper slope). Wooldridge wage panel, 545 men over 1980-1987 (nr); yeart/educt the year-trend and schooling terms, rendered year/educ. Occupation/industry dummies, d81-d87 and expersq ignored.

formula: wemp ~ husunemp + under1 + under5 + age + (1 | case)
notes: RESPONSE INFERRED: women's employment panel, woman (case) observed over time; employment (wemp, 0/1) the outcome, husband's unemployment (husunemp) and young-children indicators (under1, under5) covariates. No labels.

formula: yield ~ moist + (1 | variety)
notes: RESPONSE INFERRED: wheat variety trial, 10 varieties each grown on 6 plots; yield the outcome modelled with a variety random intercept, moist a moisture covariate, plot the replicate index. #24 cluster rule: variety repeats within the table and indexes the grouping. No labels.

formula: y ~ smoking + age + (1 | id)
notes: Steubenville childhood wheeze longitudinal data: children (id) measured repeatedly (var the occasion, age centred), wheeze (y, 0/1) the outcome, maternal smoking (smoking) the covariate. Recalled the subject random-intercept logit.

formula: bitterness ~ temp * contact + (1 | judge)
notes: Randall wine-bitterness data (the R ordinal package's wine): judges rate bitterness (1-5 ordinal) under temperature (temp) and contact; temp*contact the design. Recalled the cumulative-link mixed model with a judge random intercept. bitter the 0/1 recode (alternate response), repl the replicate. RULE GAP: fuller model adds a (1|judge:bottle) term; no bottle column here.

formula: choice ~ brand + feature + price + (1 | house)
notes: ch12 do-file: gllamm brand ... feature pricec, i(house) link(mlogit) (random-intercept multinomial/discrete choice over 4 brands). Households (house) make repeated purchases (occ); choice the chosen-brand indicator, brand the alternative, feature/price the marketing covariates. Rendered as a household random-intercept conditional logit.

formula: Surv(stop, event) ~ (1 | id)
notes: ch15 do-file: egen idnum=group(id number); stset stop, failure(event) id(idnum) in three setups (total time, counting process, gap time) for a recurrent-event survival model. Subjects (id, A/B/C...) have repeated events (number); the frailty model itself is not estimated in the do-file. Survival convention: event in Surv() and ignore, number the event sequence.

formula: lwage ~ exp + wks + occ + ind + south + smsa + ms + union + ed + fem + blk + (1 | nr)
notes: Cornwell-Rupert returns-to-schooling panel; 595 individuals (nr) over 7 years, log wage (lwage) the outcome, experience/weeks-worked/union/schooling covariates. Panel grouped by nr. Recalled the random-effects wage model.
